in_marathi.name: Umakant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Umakant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Umakant is a name derived from the Sanskrit language that means 'God of Prosperity'. It is a name that resonates with the idea of abundance and wealth, and is often given to boys in the hope that they will grow up to be prosperous and successful.
